info.title: Showroom
info.description: Showroom's JSON API: the product catalog, its workflow, and the stats, search and settings summary an admin front end reads.

counts.description: Products per status; 0 for a status without products.

completeness.description: One row per channel and locale with stored scores, by channel code then locale code.

products.description: Products scored for the channel and locale.
The products in review the longest, oldest first.

key.description: The product's identifier or the product model's code; null once it is gone.

code.description: The record's code; a product's identifier.

label.description: The record's label in the app locale, else its code; a product's identifier.

subtitle.description: A line beneath the label: an asset's filename, an owner's code and type, an attribute's code and type, else the code; null for a product.

authorization.description: Whether calls act as the signed-in user and are checked against showroom.policies.

mcp.description: The MCP server's web and local transports.

message.const: Auditing is turned off for this package.
No audit log is installed. Install refactor-circus/keen to record history.

chain.description: Tree root first, this category last.

LookupKey.description:
The column a product or owner is found by in URLs, MCP tool arguments and the actions that take one record: `showroom.lookup.products` and `showroom.lookup.owners`, or a call's own `by`. An identifier or owner code is never a lookup key: it stays an input reference only (`parent`, `owner`, associations, filters). | | |---| | `id`
The record's ULID. | | `slug`
The record's slug, set once when it is created. |
LookupKey.title: LookupKey

external_ids.description: An object even when empty, so clients always read a map.

effective_flags.description: Own plus every ancestor's; an owner cannot drop one.

parent_types.description: null: any owner type may be the parent.

values.description: Own values plus the root model's, for a sub-model.

associations.description: Own and inherited from product models.

owner.description: A variant's owner is its root model's.

categories.description: Own and inherited, as category codes.

effective_enabled.description: Set by EffectiveEnabled::load(); absent when it has not run.

published_version.description: The version storefronts read, or null when unpublished.

values.description: Own values plus everything inherited from product models.

associations.description: Own and inherited from product models.

external_ids.description: An object even when empty, so clients always read a map.

effective_flags.description: Own plus inherited from the owner chain; a product cannot drop one.

changed_at.description:
When anything the product shows last changed, inherited
changes included. What `updated_since` filters on.

ProductStatus.description: Where a product's working copy stands in review. Publishing is separate: a product has a published version or it has not.
ProductStatus.title: ProductStatus

SearchType.description: The kinds of record catalog search looks through, in the order its results come.
SearchType.title: SearchType

StartExportRequest.description: A queued export run; its result names the file asset.
StartExportRequest.title: StartExportRequest

StartImportRequest.description: A queued import run; follow it through Impex.
StartImportRequest.title: StartImportRequest

code.description: A language, optionally with a region or script: en, en_US, zh-Hant.

parent_types.description: null: any type may be the parent; a list: only these, [] for none.

Transition.description: A step through the product workflow, and the version action it records.
Transition.title: Transition

code.description: Existing associations are shaped by these; they never change.
A code is an identifier other systems hold on to; it never changes.
Product values store the option code, so it never changes.

Every stored value depends on the code and type, so neither
changes once the attribute exists.
Scopable values are keyed by channel code; it never changes.
Assignments, search filters and API clients name a flag by code; it never changes.
Stored values are keyed by locale code; it never changes.

parent_types.description: null: any type may be the parent; a list: only these, [] for none.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
